blocks.content: Explore a finished dashboard to work out what it monitors and whether its panels support a clear goal.
Read the panel titles and say in one sentence what the dashboard monitors. Then look for the specific information that would help answer that question.
Count the panels whose title alone tells you what they measure. Identify which panels support the dashboard's question and which distract from it, and look for a general-to-specific progression.
You've identified a dashboard goal and assessed its focus and readability. Next, inspect how a panel gets the data that supports that goal.
